content: Common GDPR/GA consent mistakes: loading GA/gtag before consent decision (fires tracking pre-consent); missing Consent Mode v2 default state set before tags fire; unequal prominence of Accept vs Reject (CNIL fined Google 150M EUR, Meta 60M EUR for exactly this pattern); no working Reject-All / granular option. Correct pattern: set consent defaults to denied before any GA snippet loads, gate GA initialization behind explicit consent, provide equally-weighted Accept/Reject buttons.
